document_title: Indian Boilers Act, 1923 & Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR 1950)
source_name: National Single Window System (NSWS) / UP Boilers
disclaimer: DEMO / SYNTHETIC — NOT OFFICIAL REGULATORY TEXT (Curated for SIH 2026 Prototype)

sections.title: Prohibition of use of unregistered or uncertificated boiler
sections.text: Save as otherwise expressly provided in this Act, no owner of a boiler shall use the boiler or permit it to be used unless the boiler has been duly registered in accordance with the provisions of this Act, and a valid certificate or provisional order authorizing the use of the boiler is in force under Section 7.

sections.title: Registration, Hydraulic Testing and Certificate for Use
sections.text: An industrial unit operating a steam boiler exceeding 25 litres volume with working steam pressure above 1.0 kg/cm2 must apply for registration accompanied by manufacturer certificates (Form II, III, IV), steam pipeline fabrication drawings, and certified boiler attendant credentials. Registration is granted following on-site hydraulic pressure testing by the Inspector of Boilers.
